description.value: Southridge Country Store is a family-owned specialty grocery on Pender Island, sourcing ethical meats, organic produce, specialty charcuterie, and a rotating selection of Canadian and imported cheeses. The store's in-house chef prepares soups, sandwiches, dips, pies, and seasonal items available fresh or from the freezer section. An adjoining Picnic Park provides a family-friendly outdoor space with games and board games — a convenient rest stop for cyclists exploring the island.

address.value: 3327 Port Washington Road, Pender Island, V0N 2M1
